title: How Ultrasonic Sensors See With Sound 🔊 #shorts
description:
How does a robot "see" a wall without eyes? It shouts and listens for the echo. The HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor explained in 3D:

1️⃣ TRIG gets a 10 µs pulse
2️⃣ The transmitter fires 8 pulses at 40 kHz
3️⃣ ECHO goes HIGH and the timer starts
4️⃣ The echo returns and ECHO goes LOW
📐 distance = speed of sound × time ÷ 2  (cm = µs ÷ 58)

Full explainer on the channel. Subscribe to Echo Lab 3D for more how-it-works videos!
